messages:
Mia (AE): Quick heads-up — HealthCo POC is moving to order form stage. Legal flagged DPA + a few SLA redlines. Procurement wants signers and schedule before they release PO. attaching draft order form (will post). Can Legal / Procurement advise on quickest path to sign?

Jordan (SE): Thanks — quick Q on pricing: are they moving to committed reserved or usage-based? That changes invoicing & PO wording.

Mia (AE): Committed — they want a 12-month committed pool, $60k/month. Finance prefers PO/AR Net30.

Asha (Procurement): For PO: need full billing entity legal name, tax id, remit address, and 2 signer names (primary + backup). Also need expected PO number and approval SLA (X business days). Who owns collecting these?

Mia (AE): I'll collect; tentative signers: Dana Morris (VP Finance) and Carlos Ruiz (Procurement Lead). PO number TBD — they'll issue after legal OKs DPA.

Sophia (Legal): Thanks. On DPA redlines — they added: (1) subprocessor approval step, (2) 30-day data export window, (3) lower liability cap. We can probably accept subprocessor notice + 30-day export if we tighten security attestations; liability cap needs exec sign-off. Uploading redline in thread.

Jordan (SE): Also FYI: their security questionnaire flagged SAML SSO and KMS integration requests. For KMS we offer BYOK on Private deployments only — confirm whether they need it for POC.

Mia (AE): HealthCo says yes to SSO, may want KMS later but not for initial POC. For now they need isolation and SOC2 report attached.

Asha (Procurement): For signature flow — do you want e-sign (DocuSign) with sequencing: customer signs first then Redwood countersigns? Or two-way simultaneous? Customer prefers countersign after we countersign for tax reasons.

Sophia (Legal): We prefer customer signs first; countersign automatically. If PO requires countersign before payment, flag us.

Mia (AE): Proposed sequencing: 1) HealthCo signs Order Form & DPA; 2) Redwood countersigns same day; 3) Procurement issues PO referencing order form. Is that fine?

Sophia (Legal): Fine. Send final redline to exec for liability deviation if needed.

Leo (Finance): Note: Net30 for invoice terms OK, but Finance needs a billing contact email and remittance instructions in the order form. Also need GL code mapping if they want PO matching.

Mia (AE): I'll update the order form. Quick snippet I'm adding:

```
Order Form:
Customer: HealthCo, Inc.
Billing: HealthCo Finance — finance@healthco.com
Term: 12 months
Commit: $60,000 / month
Billing Terms: Net30
Signers: Dana Morris (VP Finance), Carlos Ruiz (Proc Lead)
```

Sophia (Legal): Also add clause: "Execution by e-signature is equivalent to original."

Asha (Procurement): One more: they want a schedule showing milestone-based onboarding credits — can you confirm whether we can deliver a 2-week onboarding credit?

Jordan (SE): We can offer a $5k onboarding credit applied to first invoice; confirm in order form as "one-time credit".

Mia (AE): Cool — I'll send updated order form + redlined DPA to HealthCo legal today. Who should be in the loop for final approval?

Sophia (Legal): Include me + ops-privacy@redwood.com. If exec signoff required, cc Legal Lead: emma_r.

Leo (Finance): Add finance-billing@redwood.com for PO routing.

Mia (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll post the final attachments here when done. :thumbsup:
